sentences.en: If we had wings, could we fly to the moon?
sentences.zh: 如果我们有翅膀，我们能飞到月球吗？

sentences.en: This bird's large wings enable it to fly very fast.
sentences.zh: 这种鸟的大翅膀让它能够飞得非常快。

sentences.en: It seems a cruel thing to clip a bird's wings.
sentences.zh: 剪掉小鸟的翅膀似乎是一件残忍的事情。

senses.zh: 翼，翅膀，翅，(组织中的)派别，边锋，边房
给...装上翼，飞过，空运，打伤...的翅膀
